content.short: Kernel v2.1 provides ERC-4337 compatible smart contract accounts with transaction batching.
content.description: Kernel v2.1 provides a foundational framework for account abstraction wallets, responding to ERC-4337. It delivers ERC-4337 compatibility and supports transaction batching to simplify wallet development. A plugin framework lets developers add on-chain features without upgrading the underlying smart contract accounts, enabling smoother user migration between different wallet implementations. The approach reduces duplication by letting developers reuse core capabilities rather than building them from scratch.
